basis.build: cargo build --profile release-lto --features pcre2 --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, with PCRE2_SYS_STATIC=1 (release.yml at the tag) and -C target-feature=+crt-static (.cargo/config.toml at the tag)
basis.rule: The normal dependencies of the ripgrep package for that target and feature set, resolved the way Cargo resolves them from the locked versions: the checksum of every locked crate equals the one in the crates.io index, dependencies come from the index (kind, target cfg, optional, features) and ripgrep's workspace manifests. Dev-dependencies, build-dependencies, other targets and optional crates that no enabled feature reaches are not part of rg.exe (notLinked).

toolchain.derivedFrom: The release workflow of ripgrep at tag 15.2.0 (e89fff89) builds the Windows binary on windows-latest with dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master, toolchain `nightly` (no rust-toolchain file at the tag, no components requested). The job build-release (win-msvc, windows-latest, nightly, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc) of run 29431117779 started at 2026-07-15T16:07:59Z. The nightly manifest dist/2026-07-15/channel-rust-nightly.toml was published at 2026-07-15T01:29:39Z (the next one, of 2026-07-16, at 01:30:20Z), so `nightly` was that one: rustc "1.99.0-nightly (da80ed070 2026-07-14)", git_commit_hash da80ed0708a09dc096c184345d6eb42cbcd50a1e.
toolchain.checkedBy: test-runtime.mjs of the installer build: the bytes of rg.exe must carry /rustc/<this commit> followed by / or \ (the source paths that core and std leave in the binary); a binary that carries only other commits is refused and the commits found are named

rustStd.rule: The packages that the standard library links for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, read from the manifests of the library workspace at that commit (library/std/Cargo.toml, library/sysroot/Cargo.toml, library/unwind/Cargo.toml, library/compiler-builtins/compiler-builtins/Cargo.toml) and from library/Cargo.lock: registry crates behind a cfg(...) of another target, optional crates that no enabled feature reaches, and development and build dependencies are not part of rg.exe (notLinked). The locked checksums of the three crates that are linked equal the ones in the crates.io index. The parts of library/ that carry notices of their own (REUSE.toml, license-metadata.json and the license files of the subtrees) are components of type rust-library-part. Rust's own COPYRIGHT-library.html lists the crates of every target and ships only in the rustc component of a toolchain, which was not downloaded.

components.name: PCRE2
components.via: compiled from the sources bundled in pcre2-sys 0.2.10 (upstream/include/pcre2.h there: PCRE2_MAJOR 10, PCRE2_MINOR 46, PCRE2_DATE 2025-08-27; the release build sets PCRE2_SYS_STATIC=1)
components.rgReportsNote: rg --pcre2-version prints the PCRE2_MAJOR and PCRE2_MINOR constants of pcre2-sys/src/bindings.rs, which were generated for 10.45 and not regenerated when the bundled sources went to 10.46 (seen in the installer build on the real 15.2.0 binary, 2026-10-25). The version string that the compiled library carries is compiledVersionString (pcre2_config.c builds it from pcre2.h for PCRE2_CONFIG_VERSION); it is found in rg.exe by a byte search.
